parsed.reason: The grouping uses each timestamp's local `.date()` while sorting by absolute instant, so with mixed UTC offsets the same local day can be split into non-adjacent groups and yielded twice. The docstring promises UTC days, but the code never converts to UTC, so this is a real correctness defect whenever mixed offsets occur.
